posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
This episode had a feel of listening in on a late-night college discussion. Especially the bit debating what is an Endling and how does Jansa pick. But also the justification for space exploration stuff. Speaking as someone in the space industry, Christopher, trying to justify space exploration with more exploration is a losing proposition! Unfortunately, I don’t have a winning strategy, either.

Wagner Base sounds to me a lot like McMurdo Station in Antarctica. I would love for us to have something like that!
